description: Final verification pass: run build and typecheck, then commit all changes. The deployable app is in artifacts/electron/. All changes should be on the perf/faster-load branch.
steps: 1. Run `pnpm run typecheck` from /projects/sandbox/electron to confirm no TypeScript errors.
2. Run `PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ npx vite build --config vite.config.ts` from /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron to confirm build succeeds and observe chunk sizes.
3. Run `git -C /projects/sandbox/electron status` to see all changed files.

4. Run `git -C /projects/sandbox/electron add -A` and `git -C /projects/sandbox/electron commit -m 'perf: faster load - font preload, cache headers, chunk splitting, image lazy loading'` to commit all changes.
5. Record the build output (chunk sizes) in the findings field.
acceptance_criteria: PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ npx vite build succeeds from artifacts/electron
All changes are committed on the perf/faster-load branch
verification: git -C /projects/sandbox/electron status should show clean working tree
git -C /projects/sandbox/electron log --oneline -3 should show the new commit
findings: Build succeeded in 7.11s. Key chunk sizes (gzip): react-vendor 185.87kB (58.57kB gz), framer-vendor 122.69kB (40.03kB gz), motion-vendor 70.12kB (27.56kB gz), map-vendor 1052.94kB (284.54kB gz), index (app) 269.09kB (76.76kB gz). Chunk splitting for react and framer-motion is working correctly. Pre-existing TypeScript error TS2688 (dom-chromium-installation-events type definition) confirmed present before any perf changes - not introduced by this task. All four performance improvements are committed: font preload hint, cache headers, chunk splitting (react+framer-motion), and image lazy loading with async decoding.
